verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents in-app custom report building: reports by candidates, sources, departments, jobs, offers, openings and custom fields, plus advanced filtering and live previews. The evidence never shows the 'get the data OUT' half of the story; the cited APIs are candidate-write, partner-ingestion and job-board feeds, and event webhooks are not a reporting or export channel. missing for 10: scheduled report exports, BI/warehouse connectors, a documented reporting/data-extraction API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can build custom reports and get the data OUT — scheduled exports, BI connectors, or a documented reporting API to my warehouse

citations.quote: Build recruiting reports by candidates, sources, departments, jobs, offices, offers, openings, custom fields and more
Make filtering data straightforward and streamlined with intuitive workflows and live report previews
